visualCharacteristics.purpose: Two-column grid of white bordered rows: title link on the left, resource type label and "| PDF" download link with a red download icon on the right
visualCharacteristics.description: cards-resource (Cydem VT) is a 4/row grid with cover thumbnails and a 'Read' button; cards-faq is full-width grey Q&A boxes. This is a text-only 2-column list of compact white bordered rows with title left and type label + PDF icon link right: under 80% similar.

contentPattern.summary: 12 bordered text rows in a 2-column grid: document title link (application-note page or PDF), 'Application Note' type label, '| PDF' red download-icon link
contentPattern.structure: one row per document, one rich text cell `text`: title link paragraph + type label paragraph (e.g. "Application Note") + optional link-only paragraph "PDF" pointing at the PDF

reuseGuidance: Use for application-note / document download lists without images. For a single-column filterable list use cards-doclist.
